title: 他与她的梦 10他与她的梦 9
lines: 格林在一根路灯杆旁边停下了脚步。
旁边的木板上贴着一张告示，纸张边缘已经卷曲泛黄，但字迹还算清晰。那是这片区域的布局图——用粗糙的线条勾勒出街道的走向，标注了几个主要地点：路德维希精神病院、中央广场、旧钟楼、市场，以及一条标注为学校的虚线。
格林看了片刻，记住了路线，然后他低头看了看自己。
衣服上沾满了暗色的液体和灰尘，有些地方已经干涸结块，有些地方还是湿的。裸露的皮肤上同样斑驳不堪，血迹从指缝间渗进去，形成一道道深色的纹路。
空气里弥漫着一股铁锈和腐败的混合气味，齿轮的干扰正在慢慢减弱，这个味道现在他自己都觉得刺鼻。
格林说，他要去找爱丽丝。不能这样一身脏兮兮地去见她。不能让她看到自己这个样子——满身是血，像刚从屠宰场的碎肉堆里爬出来。
他需要清理一下，但清理需要钱。而他身上没有钱。格林抬起头，看向街道上的行人，那些身影。
他走上前去，一个行人停住了脚步。那张空白的脸转向他——像是一个在评估威胁的动物。
格林继续走近，行人举起了雨伞。它的身体微微前倾，关节发出细微的咯吱声，然后它向格林扑了过来……
“……应该够了。”
格林抛了抛手里的钱袋子，他把钱袋塞进口袋，站起来，继续向前走。
街上不止有行人。
格林走过两条街后，遇到了那些更大的东西——处刑官。它们比行人高出将近一倍，穿着暗红色的制服，手里握着巨大的斧头，刀刃上沾着干涸的深色污渍。它们走路的姿势很慢，每一步都重重地踩在地上，像是一尊移动的铜像。
格林动手解决了几个之后，就决定绕开了它们。
他不想在这里浪费时间，他需要先清理自己，然后去找爱丽丝。和这些怪物纠缠毫无意义，它们身上显然没有爱丽丝的线索，也不会告诉自己爱丽丝在哪里。
但那些在地上爬行的东西没那么好绕开。
人形的女性怪物。她们四肢着地，头发拖在地面上，像是某种腐烂的藻类。她们的关节弯曲的方向和正常人相反，爬行的时候姿势诡异，速度却快得惊人。
她们从阴暗的巷子里钻出来，慢慢爬向格林，从倒塌的墙洞中探出头，发出细碎的、像是笑声又像是哭泣的声音。
格林见那些“人？”靠的越来越近，伸脚踩住其中一只爬过来的手。
那只手的关节以不正常的角度扭过去。怪物发出一声低沉的嘶叫，缩回了阴影里。
格林松开脚，继续走。
他不知道这个地方到底怎么了。为什么会有这些东西，为什么街道会被扭曲成这样，为什么那些行人会变成无脸的空壳，为什么处刑官和爬行怪物会在这片区域游荡。
但他不感兴趣。
他只需要找到爱丽丝。
content_en:
Green stopped beside a light pole.
There is a notice posted on the wooden board next to it. The edges of the paper are curled and yellowed, but the writing is still clear. It was a layout of the area—rough lines outlining the streets and marking the main locations: Ludwig Asylum, the Central Square, the Old Clock Tower, the Marketplace, and a dotted line marking the school.
Green watched for a moment, memorizing the route, then he looked down at himself.
The clothes were stained with dark liquid and dust. Some places were dry and caked, and some were still wet. The exposed skin was also mottled, and blood seeped from between the fingers, forming dark lines.
The air was filled with a mixed smell of rust and decay, and the interference of the gears was slowly weakening. The smell was now pungent to him.
"...No."
Green said he was going to find Alice. You can't go to see her in such a dirty state. She couldn't let her see him like this - covered in blood, like he had just crawled out of a pile of minced meat in a slaughterhouse.
He needed to clean up, but cleaning up cost money. And he had no money on him. Green raised his head and looked at the pedestrians and figures on the street.
As he walked forward, a pedestrian stopped. The blank face turned toward him—like an animal assessing a threat.
Green continued to approach, and pedestrians raised their umbrellas. Its body leaned forward slightly, its joints made a slight creaking sound, and then it rushed towards Green...
"...It should be enough."
Green tossed the money bag in his hand, stuffed it into his pocket, stood up, and continued walking forward.
There are more than just pedestrians on the street.
After walking two streets, Green encountered those larger things - the Executioner. They were nearly twice as tall as pedestrians, wearing dark red uniforms and holding huge axes in their hands, the blades stained with dried dark stains. They walk very slowly, stepping heavily on the ground with each step, like a moving bronze statue.
After Green solved a few of them, he decided to avoid them.
He didn't want to waste time here, he needed to clean himself up first and then go find Alice. There is no point in getting entangled with these monsters. They obviously have no clues about Alice, and they will not tell themselves where Alice is.
But the things crawling on the ground are not so easy to get around.
Humanoid female monster. They were on all fours, their hair trailing on the ground like some kind of rotting algae. Their joints bend in the opposite direction to normal people, and their postures are weird when crawling, but their speeds are astonishingly fast.
They emerged from the dark alley, crawled slowly towards Green, poked their heads out of the collapsed wall holes, and made small sounds that sounded like laughter or crying.
Seeing those "people?" getting closer and closer, Green stretched out his foot to step on the hand of one of them crawling over.
"Click."
The joints of the hand were twisted at an abnormal angle. The monster let out a low hiss and retreated into the shadows.
Green let go of his foot and continued walking.
He didn't know what was going on with this place. Why are these things there, why are the streets twisted like this, why do pedestrians turn into faceless shells, why do executioners and crawling monsters roam this area.
But he wasn't interested.
He just needs to find Alice.
